q.q: Your brother or sister is your ___.
q.ex: A sibling is a brother or a sister. A tutor is a private teacher and a toddler is a very young child.
q.uz: Sibling – aka-uka yoki opa-singil. Tutor – repetitor, toddler – endi yura boshlagan chaqaloq.

q.q: “Take turns” means to ___.
o: do something at the same time
q.ex: When people take turns, one person goes first, then the next.
q.uz: “Take turns” – navbat bilan qilmoq: birinchi biri, keyin boshqasi.

q.q: The years when a child slowly becomes an adult are called ___.
q.ex: Adolescence is the teenage period between childhood and adulthood.
q.uz: Adolescence – o‘smirlik davri, bolalikdan kattalikka o‘tish yillari.

q.q: My aunt is very ___: she always helps and changes her plans for other people.
q.ex: Accommodating = friendly and willing to help. Stubborn is the opposite: it means refusing to change.
q.uz: Accommodating – xushmuomala, moslashuvchan. Stubborn – o‘jar, aksi.

q.q: The two brothers had a terrible ___ about who could use the computer.
q.ex: An argument is an angry disagreement. A bond is a close connection.
q.uz: Argument – janjal, tortishuv. Bond – yaqin rishta.

q.q: When you talk to someone, it is polite to make eye ___.
q.ex: The fixed phrase is “make eye contact” = look directly into someone’s eyes.
q.uz: “Eye contact” – ko‘z bilan aloqa; boshqa so‘zlar bu iborada ishlatilmaydi.

q.q: Our ___ tells us when to sleep and when to wake up.
q.ex: The body clock is the natural timing system inside your body.
q.uz: Body clock – biologik soat: uyqu va uyg‘onish vaqtini belgilaydi.

q.q: Teenagers find it hard to ___ in class if they are tired.
q.ex: Concentrate = give all your attention to one thing.

q.q: The school decided to ___ the start of lessons by one hour.
q.ex: To delay = to make something happen later.

q.q: Babies learn to walk very quickly. This stage of ___ growth is called a growth spurt.
q.ex: Rapid = very fast. A spurt is a short period of fast growth.
q.uz: Rapid – tez; growth spurt – qisqa muddatli tez o‘sish.

q.q: Students slept more. ___, their exam results improved.
q.ex: “As a result” shows a consequence. “However” and “in contrast” show a difference.

q.q: A two-year-old child who screams on the floor because he cannot have a sweet is having a ___.
q.ex: A tantrum is a sudden angry outburst, typical of small children.
q.uz: Tantrum – bolaning to‘satdan yig‘lab, jahl qilishi.

q.q: Fruit and vegetables are full of ___ that keep us healthy.
q.ex: Nutrients are substances in food that the body needs to grow and stay healthy.

q.q: Doctors say that we should ___ a healthy weight.
q.ex: Maintain = keep something at the same level.

q.q: Many people eat more than they need. This ___ can make them overweight.
q.ex: Overeating = eating too much.

q.q: Some people ___ breakfast because they have no time, but this is not healthy.
q.ex: To skip a meal = to not eat it.
q.uz: Skip a meal – ovqatni o‘tkazib yubormoq.

q.q: Which food is the most ___?
q.ex: Nutritious food is full of the substances your body needs.

q.q: Eating too much sugar is ___ to your teeth.
q.ex: Harmful = causing damage. Beneficial is the opposite.

q.q: An ___ always expects good things to happen.
q.ex: An optimist is hopeful. A pessimist expects bad results.
q.uz: Optimist – umidvor; pessimist – hamisha yomonini kutadigan.

q.q: A person who likes doing dangerous things, like extreme sports, is a ___.
q.ex: A risk-taker enjoys danger and chances.

q.q: After hard work he finally ___ his goal and became a doctor.
q.ex: Achieve = succeed in reaching something.

q.q: A bad ___ can spoil your whole day.
q.ex: Attitude = the way you think and feel about something.

q.q: “Quality of life” is ___.
q.ex: Quality of life = how happy and comfortable your life is.

q.q: You need to find a ___ between work and free time.
q.ex: Work–life balance = giving the right time to both.

q.q: A child aged three goes to ___, where he plays and sings but does not study seriously.
q.ex: Kindergarten is a school for children under six.

q.q: Students aged 6–11 attend a ___ school.
q.ex: Primary school = first stage of school.

q.q: A ___ school has only girls or only boys.
q.ex: Single-sex = only one gender. Mixed = boys and girls together.
q.uz: Single-sex – faqat o‘g‘il yoki faqat qiz bolalar uchun.

q.q: She won a ___ and did not have to pay for her studies.
q.ex: A scholarship is money given for study.

q.q: I find it easy to study at home with no ___, such as TV or background noise.
q.ex: A distraction stops you from concentrating.

q.q: The teacher gave us an ___ to complete by Friday.
q.ex: An assignment is a piece of work given to a student.

q.q: The word “rewarding” is closest in meaning to ___.
q.ex: A rewarding job or activity gives you a good feeling because it is useful.
q.uz: Rewarding – mamnuniyat bag‘ishlovchi, foydali; satisfying – qoniqarli.

q.q: Parents try to ___ their children’s social skills.
q.ex: To nurture means to care for something so that it grows.

q.q: Children with brothers and sisters are ___ to learn how to share.
q.ex: We say “be more likely to + verb”. “Probable” does not take “to + verb” in this way.
q.uz: “Be more likely to …” – ehtimoli ko‘proq. “More probable to” deb aytilmaydi.

q.q: A ___ is a person who studies something carefully to find new facts.
q.ex: A researcher is a scientist who finds new information by careful study.

q.q: A strong ___ between two friends can last for life.
q.ex: A bond is a close connection between people. Rivalry means competition.

q.q: “Sibling rivalry” is ___.
q.ex: Rivalry = a feeling of competing with someone. Sibling rivalry happens between brothers and sisters.
q.uz: Sibling rivalry – aka-uka yoki opa-singillar orasidagi raqobat.

q.q: My brother is a ___: he knocks things over and drops cups all the time.
q.ex: Clumsy = not careful or skilful with your body.
q.uz: Clumsy – ho‘l-pas, bemajol; narsalarni urib tushiradigan.

q.q: By the age of five, most children have ___ the skill of tying their shoelaces.
q.ex: Master a skill = learn to do it very well.

q.q: Old friends often sit together and ___ about their school days.
q.ex: Reminisce = talk about happy memories from the past.

q.q: Teenagers sometimes ___ against their parents’ rules.
q.ex: Rebel = refuse to obey rules.

q.q: This photo ___ me of my first day at school.
q.ex: “Remind someone of something” makes you think of it. “Remember” needs the person as subject: I remember.
q.uz: “Remind” – eslatmoq. “This photo reminds me of …” to‘g‘ri.

q.q: Travelling can ___ your mind and help you see new ideas.
q.ex: Broaden = make wider. “Travel broadens the mind” is a common saying.

q.q: A walk after dinner is ___ for your heart.
q.ex: Beneficial = good for you, useful.

q.q: To lose weight, many people try to ___ their appetite.
q.ex: To curb = to control or limit something. Appetite = the wish to eat.

q.q: You should start swimming slowly and ___ increase the time.
q.ex: Gradually = little by little. Briskly = quickly and with energy.
q.uz: Gradually – asta-sekin; briskly – tez va shijoat bilan.

q.q: The doctor ___ that I eat less salt.
q.ex: “Recommend” = advise. “Recommend that + subject + verb”.

q.q: It is important to ___ your diet and not eat the same food every day.
q.ex: Vary = change so that there is variety.

q.q: He is ___ to nuts, so he must read the label on every packet.
q.ex: “Allergic to” = your body reacts badly to something.

q.q: In my ___ time I play the guitar.
q.ex: Leisure time = free time.

q.q: Many people play games to ___ the time on a long journey.
q.ex: “Pass the time” = do something to avoid being bored.

q.q: Joining a team gives you a ___ of belonging.
q.ex: “Sense of belonging” = feeling that you are part of a group.

q.q: Her new job gave her a great ___ of fulfilment.
q.ex: Fulfilment = a feeling of satisfaction. “Sense of fulfilment” is a set phrase.

q.q: A ___ person accepts life as it is and does not expect miracles or disasters.
q.ex: A realist sees things as they really are.

q.q: Playing sport is a good ___ of getting exercise.
q.ex: “A way of + -ing” = a method.

q.q: The school ___ includes maths, history and science.
q.ex: A curriculum is the subjects taught in a school.

q.q: Many students ___ with the first year at university.
q.ex: “Struggle with” = find something very difficult.

q.q: A long piece of writing for a university degree is called a ___.
q.ex: A thesis is a long academic text, usually for a degree.

q.q: A ___ course teaches practical skills for a job, such as hairdressing.
q.ex: Vocational = connected with a particular job.

q.q: After the exam she received a ___ from the university.
q.ex: A qualification is a certificate that shows you have studied something.

q.q: A ___ student is an older person who goes back to study.
q.ex: A mature student starts university later in life.

q.q: Your ___ family means your parents, brothers and sisters.
q.ex: Immediate family = the closest relatives. Extended family also includes grandparents, aunts and cousins.
q.uz: Immediate family – eng yaqin oila a’zolari; extended family – kengroq qarindoshlar.

q.q: Teenagers often find it hard to ___ to their parents.
q.ex: “Relate to someone” = understand them and get on well with them.

q.q: Good friends know how to ___ an argument without shouting.
q.ex: We “solve” a problem or an argument = we find an answer to it.
q.uz: Solve – hal qilmoq; muammo va janjallarni hal qilamiz.

q.q: “Ijtimoiy ko‘nikmalar” in English is ___.
q.ex: Social skills = the ability to get on well with other people.
q.uz: “Social skills” – ijtimoiy ko‘nikmalar; qolgan variantlar noto‘g‘ri birikma.

q.q: A strong family ___ means you look like your parents.
q.ex: Resemblance = the way two people look alike.

q.q: A ___ is a very young child who is learning to walk.
q.ex: A toddler is usually between one and three years old.
q.uz: Toddler – endi yura boshlagan, 1–3 yoshli bola.

q.q: Children learn by ___ the adults around them.
q.ex: Imitate = copy what somebody else does.

q.q: A baby can move, but he cannot stand ___. He needs help.
q.ex: Unassisted = without help from anyone.

q.q: The move from primary school to secondary school is a big ___ in a child’s life.
q.ex: A transition is a change from one stage or state to another.
q.uz: Transition – o‘tish davri, bir bosqichdan ikkinchisiga o‘tish.

q.q: Children of the same age are called your ___.
q.ex: Your peers are the people of the same age or group as you.

q.q: He can’t ___ his phone number because he never writes it down.
q.ex: Memorise = learn something so that you can remember it exactly.

q.q: This child is very ___ for her age; she often cries and cannot wait for anything.
q.ex: Immature = behaving in a way that is too young for your age.

q.q: A big ___ of pasta is too much for a small child.
q.ex: A portion is the amount of food served to one person.

q.q: Exercise can ___ stress and anxiety.
q.ex: “Reduce” = make smaller.

q.q: Someone who gets angry easily is ___.
q.ex: Irritable = easily annoyed. Cheerful and calm are positive.

q.q: Doctors are still looking for a ___ for the disease.
q.ex: A cure is a medicine or treatment that makes an illness go away.

q.q: After the operation she needed a week to ___.
q.ex: Recover = get well again after illness.

q.q: “Moderate exercise” means ___.
o: not too hard and not too easy
q.ex: Moderate = average, not extreme.
q.uz: Moderate – o‘rtacha: na juda og‘ir, na juda yengil.

q.q: The shoe was ___ with a lace.
q.ex: Fasten = close or join something firmly.

q.q: The inventor ___ his new zip in 1913.
q.ex: To patent = to get an official right to be the only person to make an invention.

q.q: The zip is stuck – it is ___ and will not move.
q.ex: Jammed = stuck, unable to move.

q.q: A ___ shoe is comfortable and good for everyday use.
q.ex: Practical = useful in real life.

q.q: Tying lots of shoelaces is slow and ___.
q.ex: Tiring = making you feel you need rest.

q.q: It is hard to keep a healthy balance, so we all have our ups and ___.
q.ex: “Ups and downs” = good and bad times.

q.q: Many students use ___ learning because they live far from the university.
q.ex: Distance learning = studying away from the school, e.g. online.

q.q: If you are weak in maths, you can get extra help from a private ___.
q.ex: A tutor teaches one student or a small group.

q.q: The project could not start because there was no ___ for it.
q.ex: Funding = money for a project.

q.q: Which of the sentences is correct?
q.ex: “Receive” is followed by the object directly. The passive “was received” is wrong here.
q.uz: “She received a scholarship” – to‘g‘ri; “receive” dan keyin to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri ob’ekt keladi.

q.q: You should ___ the cost of books when you plan your budget.
q.ex: “Take into account” = consider.

q.q: A doctor has a very narrow ___ of specialisation: only children’s hearts.
q.ex: “Area of specialisation” = the subject a person knows best.

q.q: A ___ is a person who studies languages scientifically.
q.ex: A linguist studies how languages work.

q.q: In the mountain valley, villagers ___ to each other across great distances.
q.ex: To whistle = make a high sound by blowing through your lips.
q.uz: Whistle – hushtak chalmoq: qishloq aholisi uzoqdan hushtak orqali gaplashadi.

q.q: The voice goes up and down. This is called ___.
q.ex: Pitch = how high or low a sound or voice is.

q.q: She speaks English ___: she never stops to search for a word.
q.ex: Fluently = smoothly and easily, without long pauses.

q.q: After the long meeting, he was ___ because nobody explained the plan to him.
q.ex: Puzzled = confused, not able to understand.

q.q: Someone says, “It’s very hot today!” You agree strongly. You say, “___!”
q.ex: “You can say that again” = I completely agree.
q.uz: “You can say that again” – «Mutlaqo haqsiz!», qattiq rozilik bildirish.

q.q: A small, calm part of the sea with land around it is a ___.
q.ex: A bay is a curve of the coast with calm water.

q.q: At the ___, fishing boats unload their catch every morning.
q.ex: A harbour is a sheltered place for boats.

q.q: We went ___ in the clear water to see the colourful fish.
q.ex: Snorkelling = swimming with a mask and breathing tube.
q.uz: Snorkelling – niqob va nay bilan suzish.

q.q: The sea was a beautiful ___ colour, between blue and green.
q.ex: Turquoise is a blue-green colour.

q.q: A wooden house in the mountains, popular with skiers, is a ___.
q.ex: A chalet is a wooden mountain house.

q.q: The ___ is crowded in summer; thousands of tourists arrive every day.
q.ex: A resort is a place where people go on holiday.

q.q: People who hunt animals and gather plants for food are called ___.
q.ex: Hunter-gatherers lived before farming.

q.q: A scientist who studies ancient remains is an ___.
q.ex: Archaeologists dig up old objects.

q.q: The ___ revealed tools that were thousands of years old.
q.ex: An excavation is a careful dig.

q.q: A ___ period is a time before written history.
q.ex: Prehistoric = from before records were kept.

q.q: A period of one thousand years is called a ___.
q.ex: Millennium = 1,000 years. Century = 100 years.

q.q: This old village ___ Rome by hundreds of years.
q.ex: “Predate” = exist before something else.

q.q: Dinosaurs became ___ millions of years ago.
q.ex: Extinct = no longer existing.

q.q: A bird’s body is covered with ___.
q.ex: Birds have feathers; fish have scales; many mammals have fur.
q.uz: Feathers – patlar; fur – mo‘yna; scales – tangachalar.

q.q: The sharp ___ of a rose can hurt your finger.
q.ex: A thorn is a sharp point on a plant.

q.q: The tiger caught the deer with its sharp ___.
q.ex: Claws are the sharp nails of an animal.

q.q: Plants take water from the soil through their ___.
q.ex: Roots are the part of the plant under the ground.

q.q: The wild animal was ___ into the forest after the treatment.
q.ex: Release = let free.

q.q: A machine that goes around the Earth and sends back pictures is a ___.
q.ex: A satellite orbits a planet.

q.q: The ___ was launched from the base at dawn.
q.ex: A rocket carries things into space.

q.q: A person who travels into space is an ___.
q.ex: Astronaut = space traveller.

q.q: Our Sun belongs to a ___ called the Milky Way.
q.ex: A galaxy is a huge group of stars.

q.q: The Moon’s surface is full of ___.
q.ex: A crater is a large round hole.

q.q: The ___ is the line where the sky seems to meet the ground.
q.ex: Horizon = visible line between land and sky.

q.q: “___, the test was difficult, but I still enjoyed it.” The speaker adds a contrast.
q.ex: “Having said that” = but also; it introduces a different point.
q.uz: “Having said that” – shunday bo‘lsa-da; qarama-qarshi fikr qo‘shadi.

q.q: “___, you should arrive on time for an exam.” This is something everyone knows.
q.ex: “Needless to say” = it is obvious that…
q.uz: “Needless to say” – shubhasiz, aytish ham shart emas.

q.q: “The film was boring, to say the ___.”
q.ex: Fixed phrase: “to say the least” = it was even worse than I say.
q.uz: “To say the least” – yumshoq qilib aytganda.

q.q: People should have a ___ in decisions that affect them.
q.ex: “Have a say” = be allowed to give your opinion.
q.uz: “Have a say” – fikr bildirish huquqiga ega bo‘lmoq.

q.q: Learning a language: the greatest ___ is often fear of making mistakes.
q.ex: An obstacle is something that stops you from making progress.

q.q: A teacher should ___ students to speak, not laugh at their errors.
q.ex: Encourage = give someone confidence to do something.

q.q: We stayed in a cheap ___ with a bunk bed and a common room.
q.ex: A hostel is a cheap place to sleep, often shared.

q.q: They travelled with a rucksack and slept in cheap places. They were ___.
q.ex: Backpacking = travelling cheaply with a bag on your back.

q.q: The path to the top is very ___, so wear good shoes.
q.ex: Steep = rising sharply.

q.q: The view from the hotel was ___: mountains, lake and forest.
q.ex: Spectacular = very impressive to look at.

q.q: The cabin was ___ with a warm fire and soft sofas.
q.ex: Cosy = warm, comfortable and friendly.

q.q: The tavern ___ the harbour, so you can watch the boats from your table.
q.ex: “Overlook” = have a view over.

q.q: The sea slowly ___ the cliff; every year it gets smaller.
q.ex: Erode = wear away slowly.

q.q: An old village was built on a ___ where boats could land.
q.ex: A pier is a platform built into the water.

q.q: This bridge ___ the river and connects two cities.
q.ex: “Span” = reach across.

q.q: Be careful with this glass: it is very ___.
q.ex: Fragile = easily broken.

q.q: He sat ___ in his book and did not hear us.
q.ex: Engrossed = completely interested in something.

q.q: The library book is ___: you should have returned it last week.
q.ex: Overdue = late.

q.q: The beavers built a ___ across the stream and made a pond.
q.ex: A dam holds back water.

q.q: The ___ fish are in danger of dying out.
q.ex: Endangered = in danger of extinction.

q.q: A desert is an ___ region: it has very little rain.
q.ex: Arid = very dry.

q.q: Heavy rain caused a ___ and the fields were under water.
q.ex: A flood = too much water covering the land.

q.q: The bird made a ___ in the tree to lay its eggs.
q.ex: A nest is a bird’s home.

q.q: A small, still pool of water is a ___.
q.ex: A pond is smaller than a lake.

q.q: The layer of gases around the Earth is the ___.
q.ex: The atmosphere protects life on Earth.

q.q: Astronauts train in a ___ that copies conditions in space.
q.ex: A simulator imitates real conditions.
q.uz: Simulator – real sharoitni taqlid qiluvchi qurilma.

q.q: In space there is no gravity, so you experience ___.
q.ex: Weightlessness = feeling that your body has no weight.

q.q: It takes the Moon 27 days to travel around the Earth in its ___.
q.ex: An orbit is the path of an object around a planet.

q.q: It will take time for astronauts to ___ to life without gravity.
q.ex: Acclimatise = get used to new conditions.

q.q: It is ___ to build a base on Mars, but very expensive.
q.ex: Feasible = possible.

q.q: The speaker ___ for a moment, then continued.
q.ex: Pause = stop for a short time.

q.q: Many people ___ English as the language of business.
q.ex: “Regard X as Y” = think of X as Y.

q.q: Good grammar is the ___ of a language; you build everything else on it.
q.ex: Foundation = the base of something.

q.q: “Native speakers” are people who ___.
q.ex: A native speaker learned that language from birth.
q.uz: Native speaker – tilni bolaligidan o‘rgangan, ona tili sifatida biladigan odam.

q.q: I could not follow the talk. The speaker’s ___ was unclear.
q.ex: Pronunciation = the way you say words.

q.q: Which sentence is correct?
o: He said that he was tired.
He said me that he was tired.
He told that he was tired.
He spoke that he was tired.
q.ex: “Say” has no personal object; “tell” needs one (told me). “Speak” is for languages or talking.
q.uz: “Say that…” to‘g‘ri; “told me” kerak, “said me” noto‘g‘ri.

q.q: A ___ lets cars and passengers cross the water.
q.ex: A ferry is a boat that carries people and vehicles across water.

q.q: The road is dangerous in winter because the ice is ___.
q.ex: Treacherous = dangerous in a hidden way.

q.q: The luxury hotel gives guests a ___ experience, with massages and room service.
q.ex: Pampered = treated with great care and luxury.

q.q: You can have a holiday without spending a ___.
q.ex: “Spend a fortune” = spend a very large amount of money.
q.uz: “Spend a fortune” – juda ko‘p pul sarflamoq.

q.q: Traffic ___ make the city centre noisy and stressful.
q.ex: A traffic jam = a long line of cars that cannot move.

q.q: “Island hopping” means ___.
o: travelling from one island to another
q.ex: Hopping = moving from one place to another quickly.

q.q: He ___ at the stars for hours.
q.ex: Gaze = look steadily for a long time.

q.q: The artist made a quick ___ of the old tower.
q.ex: A sketch is a quick drawing.

q.q: The disease had a heavy ___ on the island’s population.
q.ex: “Take a heavy toll” = cause great damage or loss.

q.q: It is an ___ chair; it is two hundred years old.
q.ex: Antique = very old and valuable.

q.q: He won three ___ races: first, second and third in a row.
q.ex: Consecutive = one after another without a break.

q.q: She is a ___ woman of about forty-five.
q.ex: Middle-aged = between about 40 and 60.

q.q: The river flows ___ from the mountains to the sea.
q.ex: Downstream = in the same direction as the water flows.

q.q: Wildlife ___ helps protect rare animals.
q.ex: Management = looking after or controlling something.

q.q: Over millions of years, animals ___ and adapt to their environment.
q.ex: Evolve = develop gradually.

q.q: These crops are ___ modified so that they resist insects.
q.ex: Genetically modified = changed at the level of genes.

q.q: Farmers had to ___ their animals when the dam was built.
q.ex: Relocate = move to a new place.

q.q: The soil is very ___; farmers can grow almost anything.
q.ex: Valuable = useful or worth a lot.

q.q: The engine will ___ the rocket into space.
q.ex: Propel = push something forward with force.

q.q: Objects without gravity ___ in the air.
q.ex: Float = stay on or in the air without falling.
q.uz: Float – suzib yurmoq, havoda muallaq turmoq.

q.q: Is it possible to ___ human life on another planet?
q.ex: Sustain = keep something going.

q.q: Old satellites ___ the clutter in space.
q.ex: “Add to” = make bigger.

q.q: When a satellite falls back to Earth, it will ___ in the atmosphere.
q.ex: “Burn up” = be destroyed by heat.

q.q: The company sells tickets for ___ flights into space, so anybody can pay to go.
q.ex: Commercial = for business and profit.

q.q: A small machine or tool made for a special job is a ___.
q.ex: A device is a piece of equipment made for a particular purpose.

q.q: The factory keeps its goods in a large ___.
q.ex: A warehouse is a big building for storing things.

q.q: Nobody ___ to use the lift, because they thought the rope might break.
q.ex: “Dare” = be brave enough to do something.

q.q: The owner decided to ___ the company and open three new shops.
q.ex: Expand = become bigger.

q.q: The tall skyscraper became a famous city ___.
q.ex: A landmark is a building people recognise easily.

q.q: The old hotel was in poor condition, so the council decided to ___ it and build a new one.
q.ex: Demolish = pull down a building. Renovate = repair and improve.
q.uz: Demolish – buzib tashlamoq; renovate – ta’mirlab yangilamoq.

q.q: An electric machine that washes plates is a ___.
q.ex: A dishwasher cleans dishes automatically.

q.q: A ___ mixes fruit and milk to make a drink.
q.ex: A blender mixes food into a liquid.

q.q: A ___ connection does not need a cable.
q.ex: Wireless = without wires.

q.q: The new phone is ___: even a child can use it.
q.ex: User-friendly = easy to use.

q.q: Early computers were ___ and took up a whole room.
q.ex: Bulky = large and awkward to carry.

q.q: Machines can ___ the boring jobs that people did before.
q.ex: “Take over” = start doing something instead of someone else.

q.q: A company that works in many countries is a ___ company.
